fixed.summary: GTAO reads its far taps from a MIP chain of the view depth (XeGTAO's depth prefilter, a new `depth-mips` compute pass before `ao` where the device has compute) instead of the full-resolution depth: the same occlusion at less GPU time per frame, most at high resolutions and large aoRadius. og.render's gpuPasses and `og run --trace` list the new pass.
